summary: Grab Holdings Ltd filed a 6-K announcing it will consolidate PT Super Bank Indonesia Tbk (Superbank) after Singtel Alpha Investments transfers its shareholding to GXS Bank, Grab's digital banking subsidiary and joint venture with Singtel. Grab's combined direct and indirect stake in Superbank will increase to over 50%, making Superbank a subsidiary consolidated into Grab's Financial Services segment. The transfer is expected to close in May 2026. Superbank reported its first full-year profit in FY2025 and had a market capitalization of US$1.6 billion. No price/share, premium, or advisor was disclosed. Watch for OJK regulatory approvals and the exact closing date.
